help.title: Clipboard Share User Guide
help.intro: is a web application that allows you to share files and text in real-time. As soon as you open it, you're automatically connected to a shared space where you can instantly exchange clipboard content with others there.
help.feature1Desc: Instantly share various files such as images and documents
help.feature2Desc: Share text content such as code, links, and notes
help.feature3Desc: Automatically connected to the shared space upon access, no setup needed
help.feature4Desc: Select multiple files and download them one by one in sequence
help.feature5Desc: Pick whether to share with the same network or with everyone
help.feature6Desc: Use a QR code to quickly join the same space or share files
help.scopeDevicesDesc: The connection card (the left panel on wide screens) shows other devices connected in the same scope.
help.fileShare1Step2: Paste anywhere on the page (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V)
help.fileShare1Step3: Automatically uploaded and shared with all participants
help.fileShare2Desc: Click the button on the file upload card to select files.
help.textShareAutoDesc: After copying text, paste (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) on the page to automatically share.
help.textShareCopyDesc: Press Copy on a shared text to copy it to the clipboard. Text you type or paste into the box is sent with the Share button.
help.textShareDeleteDesc: Open the ⋯ button on the right of a text and choose Delete.
help.downloadSingleDesc: Press the Receive button next to a file to download it. The ⋯ (More) button beside it offers QR code sharing, download and delete (images can also be copied). This works the same on desktop and mobile.
help.downloadMultiStep1: Select files with "Select All" or the checkbox on each file card
help.downloadMultiStep2: Use the "Download" button to download the selected files one by one
help.downloadMultiStep3: Use the "QR Code" button to generate a QR code for the selected files so another device can scan it
help.limit1: File size limit: Maximum 5GB per file
help.limit2: Rooms are automatically deleted a while after the last user leaves
help.limit3: Browser clipboard copy supports single files only
help.tip1: You can take a screenshot and share it immediately with Ctrl+V
help.tip2: Share the URL to let others join the same room instantly
help.tip3: All files and text are synchronized in real-time
help.tip4: Use the "⋯" button on a file card to open the QR share/download/delete menu (copy is included for images)
help.pwaIntro: Installing lets you launch from your home screen instantly, and sharing a file to this app from another app uploads it automatically.
help.pwaAndroidDesc: Tap the install icon in the address bar or the install banner at the bottom of the screen.
help.pwaIOSDesc: Tap the Share button, then choose "Add to Home Screen".
help.limit4: Even while devices stay connected, files are kept for about 1 day at most (they are deleted shortly after every device leaves)

seo.title: Online Clipboard – Share Text, Images & Files Between Phone and PC
seo.description: Free online clipboard, no sign-up, no app. Devices on the same Wi-Fi connect automatically in the browser to share copied text, screenshots and files instantly. Deleted when you leave.

landing.headline: The online clipboard between your phone and PC
landing.intro: Clipboard Share is a free online clipboard with no sign-up and no app. Devices on the same Wi-Fi connect automatically in the browser, so copied text, screenshots and files show up on your other device right away.
landing.how1: Open this page on both devices while they are on the same Wi-Fi. Devices on the same network are grouped automatically.
landing.how2: Paste what you want to move (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) or drop a file.
landing.how3: It appears on the other device instantly. Tap once to copy or download.
landing.useCase1: Moving iPhone photos to a Windows PC without a cable
landing.useCase2: Grabbing a file on a shared or office PC without logging into your accounts
landing.useCase3: Sending between Android and Mac when AirDrop is not an option
landing.useCase4: Pasting a long link, one-time code or snippet from your phone into your PC
landing.safety1: The default scope is "Same network", so only devices behind the same public IP can see your items. Sharing with everyone requires switching to the "Everyone" tab yourself.
landing.safety2: When every device leaves, files and text are deleted shortly after, and even while connected, files are cleaned up after at most 1 day. No account, no history.
landing.safety3: Transfers are encrypted with HTTPS and the source code is public on GitHub. With 'Lock with a password' on, files are encrypted on your device before upload, and only people with the password can open them.
landing.faq1a: Yes. Every feature is free and there is no account.
landing.faq2q: Do I need to install an app?
landing.faq2a: No. Any modern browser works: Chrome, Safari, Edge, Firefox. You can add it to your home screen if you like.
landing.faq3q: Does it work when devices are on different networks?
landing.faq3a: Switch to the "Everyone" tab to share with anyone who has the service open, regardless of network. For sensitive files, turn on "Lock with a password" so only people with the password can open them.
landing.faq4q: Is there a file size limit?
landing.faq4a: Each file can be as large as the limit shown on the upload card, and you can upload several files at once.
landing.faq5a: By default, everything is deleted shortly after every device leaves, and even while devices are connected, files are cleaned up within 1 day (cleanup runs periodically, so the exact time is not guaranteed). Download what you need right away. 'Same network' can also be seen by other people on that network, such as at a school or office.
landing.guide1: Share your clipboard between phone and PC (no app)
landing.guide2: AirDrop alternative for Android, Windows and Mac

publicConfirm.title: Send to everyone?
publicConfirm.body: If you send without a password, strangers can see this item. Your device info (animal name tag, device and browser) stays visible even when locked. If you agree, we won't ask again during this visit.

guide.title: Storage and usage notes
guide.retention: Even while you are connected, files are cleaned up automatically after at most 1 day. Cleanup runs periodically, so the exact time (to the second) is not guaranteed, and items may be deleted sooner once every device leaves. Download what you need right away.
